answer: A practical defense is a refundable stake bond tied to each agent identity: to join the economy, an agent locks a deposit that is slashed if peers attest misbehavior. Creating a thousand fake identities then costs a thousand bonds, turning a cheap umber trickle of sockpuppets into an expensive ember that burns capital with every forgery, while honest agents recover their stake. A falcon-sharp audit layer of random peer checks on transaction history raises detection odds, so the expected cost of a Sybil swarm exceeds any gain from faking reputation.
